name: Cuegle
body:
Cuegle
CR 5

This alien-like creature only vaguely resembles a humanoid; its body is covered in coarse, black hair, and three tentacle-like appendages sprout from its torso—two from the shoulders, and the third from the center of its torso. A curving horn rises from its forehead, beneath which are three large, round eyes: one blue, one red, and one green.

XP 1,600
NE Medium aberration (extraplanar)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +6 natural)
hp 52 (7d8+21)
Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +8

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +10 (1d6+5), 3 tentacles +5 (1d4+2)
Special Attacks endless teeth, temporal gaze

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 15, Con 15, Int 12, Wis 17, Cha 14
Base Atk +5; CMB +10; CMD 22
Feats Alertness, Cleave, Power Attack, Toughness
Skills Intimidate +12, Perception +15, Sense Motive +12, Survival +13
Languages Aklo (cannot speak); telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Endless Teeth (Ex)

Whenever a cuegle confirms a critical hit against a target with its bite attack, it gains another bite attack against the same target in the same round as a free action. This ability can be used more than once in the same round.

Temporal Gaze (Sp)

As a standard action, the cuegle can fix one of its three eyes on an opponent during a combat, reading the opponent’s past, present, and future and using this knowledge to hurt the enemy and protect itself from attacks. Each eye has a different spell-like effect. The red eye functions as anticipate thoughts (DC 14), the blue one as mindshock, and the green one as true strike. The blue and green eye’s effects only work on attacks against the target opponent. The cuegle can use only one eye at a time on the same opponent, and each opponent can be the target of each eye only once during a combat. The cuegle can change the target of each eye as a standard action. Save DCs are Charisma-based.

Vulnerability to Oak and Holly (Ex)

The cuegle cannot stand the touch of holly or oak wood. Weapons made of these materials ignore the cuegle’s damage reduction. In addition, a structure or object made of holly or oak wood protects creatures within it from the cuegle as a combined sanctuary (save DC 15) and magic circle against evil.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land (Dimension of Dreams)
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Though vaguely humanoid in form, the cuegle is not a thing of the natural world, rather being native to the Dimension of Dream. These alien creatures stand about four and a half feet tall, with a broad, bipedal body. The resemblance to a humanoid ends there, as its body is covered in coarse, black hair, and three tentacle-like appendages sprout from its torso—two from the shoulders, and the third from the center of its torso. These arms are more like tails or extensions of its spine, composed of vertebrae and powerful muscles, able to writhe and constrict like a snake. A curving horn rises from its forehead, beneath which are three large, round eyes: one blue, one red, and one green. The eyes can move independently of one another. Its mouth has five rows of teeth, and its jaws extend outward from the skull when it bites, allowing it to use all its teeth to rend and tear its prey.

Cuegle are cruel predators, preferring to hunt sentient prey.

They prey upon the solitary, the weak, and the undefended. If its favored prey are inaccessible, they will sustain themselves on pets and livestock, if only to cause grief to those on which it would prefer to feed. Cuegle attacks are typically stealthy, with the creature attempting to kill or subdue its prey quickly before carrying it off to its lair: typically, a cave or ruin nearby.

Cuegle lair within a few miles of local humanoid settlements if possible.

The eyes of a cuegle have sight beyond the norm, piercing the temporal veil. Its central red eye sees the present and the blue eye sees into the past, while the green eye sees into the future. Focusing these eyes on a creature allows the cuegle to see through the expanse of the creature’s timeline, giving it insight into the creature and its future and past deeds.

A cuegle’s palate is influenced by what it sees in the timeline of its victims. The choicest morsels are innocents it views, with its green eye, that will commit great evils in the future. Only slightly less delectable are goodly individuals who have redeemed themselves of evil acts in the past, seen through its blue eye.

This fiendish beast creature has a predilection for stealing newborns at the beginning of their timeline, and any child in a cradle is in danger. What happens to the babies it steals is not known; The only thing that is certain is that they are never seen again. Because of its aversion to oak and holly, wood from these trees is often placed in babies’ cradles to protect them.
